scope: Selected preliminary two-stage road platform on an already accepted earth formation: single 150mm crushed stone M1200 base plus one 50mm hot dense fine asphalt layer. This is not a universal pavement design.

source.authority: Ministry of Construction of the Kyrgyz Republic

All operators and operating fuel are included in their machine rows. Individual contractor tooling is included in base labor. Asphalt rolling remains in the accepted paving operation.
